english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) and (6) of the Dogs (Protection of Livestock) Act 1953.

english.notes:
(i) From 18/03/26, due to changes made by the Dogs (Protection of Livestock) (Amendment) Act 2025, this offence applies and replaces H592.
(ii) Section 1(2) of the Dogs (Protection of Livestock) Act 1953 defines ‘worrying livestock’ for this offence as chasing livestock in such a way as may reasonably be expected to cause injury or suffering to the livestock or, in the case of females, abortion, or loss of or diminution in their produce, or being at large, i.e. not on a lead or otherwise under close control, in a field or enclosure in which there are sheep.
(iii) See section 1(3), (3A) and (4) of the Dogs (Protection of Livestock) Act 1953 for defences available.
(iv) Also consider the following offences:
H102636 - owner of a dog worrying livestock,
H569 - dog not under proper control (complaint only),
H11472 - owner / person in charge of dog dangerously out of control causing injury
H11473 - owner / person in charge of a dog dangerously out of control - no injury
